verdict.rationale: Warp documents a settings file for 'programmatic control over settings and easy portability between devices' and open-sources its client code, but there's no documented feature for exporting conversation history, Warp Drive workflows, or agent run data in open formats for full user data portability. missing for 10: explicit full data export tooling, open-format export of conversation/session history, Warp Drive workflow export, independent confirmation users can fully migrate away with their data.
